description: An open-source UI component library for building high-quality, accessible design systems and web apps for Vue. Previously Radix Vue

latest_release.name: v2.11.0
latest_release.body:
###    🚀 Features

- Add TagGroup component  -  by @yan-ad and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2684 [<samp>(485cf)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/485cfd2b)
- Add `loop` keyboard navigation to Listbox, Select and Tree  -  by @zernonia and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2981 [<samp>(67409)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/67409e4e)
- **Calendar/RangeCalendar**:
  - Enhanced keyboard navigation with Home/End/PageUp/PageDown shortcuts  -  by @epr3 and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2530 [<samp>(3f836)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/3f836525)
- **Checkbox**:
  - Add max prop  -  by @malik-jouda in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2058 [<samp>(72355)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/7235598f)
- **Combobox**:
  - Add unmountOnHide prop  -  by @onmax and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2842 [<samp>(22ec2)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/22ec2bc2)
- **Drawer**:
  - Add DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider for software keyboards  -  by @zernonia and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2889 [<samp>(e65ad)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/e65add53)
- **Field,Form**:
  - Add Field and Form primitives  -  by @zernonia and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2830 [<samp>(c0d26)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/c0d267f5)
- **Menu**:
  - Allow grace customization  -  by @J-Michalek and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/1771 [<samp>(472b5)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/472b5b87)
- **Number Field**:
  - Add startingValue prop for increment/decrement  -  by @rikzwarthoff in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2628 [<samp>(e9230)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/e9230140)
- **NumberField**:
  - Add allowInvalid prop  -  by @xerox0213 in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2761 [<samp>(43a8e)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/43a8e6ae)
- **Select/Listbox/Combobox/Menu/ContextMenu/DropdownMenu/Menubar/ColorSwatchPicker**:
  - Add  slot prop to `*Item` and `forceMount` to `*ItemIndicator`  -  by @kricsleo and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2562 [<samp>(90c17)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/90c175aa)
- **Toast**:
  - Allow action without dismissing toast  -  by @yan-ad and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2673 [<samp>(76cd1)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/76cd1ac1)
  - Add toast manager  -  by @zernonia and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2985 [<samp>(6c047)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/6c047940)

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- Respect defaultPrevented in trigger event handlers  -  by @zernonia and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2984 [<samp>(b9a0e)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/b9a0e2d8)
- Regressions found in the 2.11.0 release review  -  by @zernonia and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2991 [<samp>(29926)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/29926c77)
- **Autocomplete**:
  - Clear stale filter when cancelling a blurred input  -  by @zernonia and **Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)** in https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/issues/2989 [<samp>(94965)</samp>](https://github.com/unovue/reka-ui/commit/94965eed)
- **Calendar**:
  - Keep the visible month when modelValue is a new object for the same day
